<!-- PumOrga Praxis 0.9.16 · komplette App · ohne Zugangssperre (Zugang regelt die Kurs-/Seitenfreigabe) -->
<div id="hygienewerk-app" style="width:100%;max-width:100%;margin:0 auto">
<p id="hw-load" style="font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,Segoe UI,Roboto,sans-serif;padding:40px 16px;text-align:center;color:#16323a">PumOrga Praxis wird geladen …</p>
<iframe id="hw-frame" title="PumOrga Praxis" style="display:none;width:100%;height:88vh;min-height:640px;border:0;border-radius:14px;background:#f3f7f4" allow="clipboard-write; fullscreen" allowfullscreen></iframe>
</div>
<script>
(async function(){var L=document.getElementById("hw-load"),F=document.getElementById("hw-frame");try{var b=atob(""),u=new Uint8Array(b.length);for(var i=0;i<b.length;i++)u[i]=b.charCodeAt(i);
var t=await new Response(new Blob([u]).stream().pipeThrough(new DecompressionStream("gzip"))).text();
F.srcdoc=t;F.style.display="block";L.style.display="none";}catch(e){L.textContent="PumOrga Praxis konnte nicht geladen werden. Bitte einen aktuellen Browser verwenden (Safari ab Version 16.4, Chrome, Edge oder Firefox).";}})();
</script>
<style>
#hygienewerk-app .hw-bar{display:none;justify-content:flex-end;margin:0 0 6px}
#hygienewerk-app.hw-ready .hw-bar{display:flex}
#hygienewerk-app .hw-fs{font:600 14px/1 system-ui,-apple-system,Segoe UI,Roboto,sans-serif;color:#fff;background:#1f8c6f;border:0;border-radius:999px;padding:9px 16px;cursor:pointer;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px}
#hygienewerk-app .hw-fs:hover{background:#18735b}
#hygienewerk-app:fullscreen{box-sizing:border-box;background:#f3f7f4;padding:10px;overflow:hidden;width:100%;height:100%;max-width:none}
#hygienewerk-app:-webkit-full-screen{box-sizing:border-box;background:#f3f7f4;padding:10px;overflow:hidden;width:100%;height:100%;max-width:none}
#hygienewerk-app:fullscreen #hw-frame{height:calc(100vh - 62px)!important;min-height:0!important}
#hygienewerk-app:-webkit-full-screen #hw-frame{height:calc(100vh - 62px)!important;min-height:0!important}
#hygienewerk-app.hw-full{position:fixed!important;inset:0;z-index:2147483000;box-sizing:border-box;background:#f3f7f4;padding:10px;width:100%!important;max-width:none!important;height:100vh;height:100dvh;overflow:hidden}
#hygienewerk-app.hw-full #hw-frame{height:calc(100vh - 62px)!important;height:calc(100dvh - 62px)!important;min-height:0!important}
@media print{#hygienewerk-app .hw-bar{display:none!important}}
</style>
<script>
(function(){
 var app=document.getElementById("hygienewerk-app"),F=document.getElementById("hw-frame");if(!app||!F||app.querySelector(".hw-bar"))return;
 var bar=document.createElement("div");bar.className="hw-bar";
 var btn=document.createElement("button");btn.type="button";btn.className="hw-fs";btn.setAttribute("aria-pressed","false");
 bar.appendChild(btn);app.insertBefore(bar,app.firstChild);
 var prevOverflow="";
 function fsEl(){return document.fullscreenElement||document.webkitFullscreenElement||null}
 function active(){return fsEl()===app||app.classList.contains("hw-full")}
 function update(){var a=active();btn.textContent=a?"\u2715 Vollbild beenden":"\u26F6 Vollbild";btn.setAttribute("aria-pressed",String(a))}
 function closeOverlay(){if(!app.classList.contains("hw-full"))return;app.classList.remove("hw-full");document.documentElement.style.overflow=prevOverflow;update()}
 function openOverlay(){prevOverflow=document.documentElement.style.overflow;document.documentElement.style.overflow="hidden";app.classList.add("hw-full");update()}
 function exit(){if(app.classList.contains("hw-full")){closeOverlay();return}
  if(fsEl()===app){var p=document.exitFullscreen?document.exitFullscreen():document.webkitExitFullscreen?document.webkitExitFullscreen():null;if(p&&p.catch)p.catch(function(){})}}
 function enter(){var rq=app.requestFullscreen||app.webkitRequestFullscreen;
  if(!rq){openOverlay();return}
  try{var p=rq.call(app);if(p&&p.then)p.then(update,function(){openOverlay()});else setTimeout(function(){if(!fsEl())openOverlay();else update()},300)}catch(e){openOverlay()}}
 btn.addEventListener("click",function(){if(active())exit();else enter()});
 document.addEventListener("fullscreenchange",update);document.addEventListener("webkitfullscreenchange",update);
 function onKey(e){if((e.key==="Escape"||e.key==="Esc")&&active())exit()}
 document.addEventListener("keydown",onKey);
 function hookFrame(){try{var w=F.contentWindow;if(w&&!w.__hwEsc){w.__hwEsc=1;w.document.addEventListener("keydown",onKey)}}catch(e){}}
 F.addEventListener("load",hookFrame);
 function ready(){if(F.style.display!=="none"){app.classList.add("hw-ready");hookFrame();return true}return false}
 if(!ready()){var mo=new MutationObserver(function(){if(ready())mo.disconnect()});mo.observe(F,{attributes:true,attributeFilter:["style"]})}
 update();
})();
</script>
